column8: Script

Jake: hey man are you done with that power drill I lent you last week?
Sam: oh shoot sorry Jake! completely forgot about it 🤦‍♂️
Jake: no worries dude just need it for a quick fix in the kitchen this afternoon
Sam: i can drop it by your porch in about 10 mins if that works?
Jake: perfect that saves me a trip.
Sam: done! left it right behind the planter box so nobody grabs it
Jake: got it, thanks neighbor 🍻
Sam: anytime! let me know if you need help with the kitchen

Sarah: Good morning, David. I hope you had a restful weekend.
David: Good morning, Sarah. I did, thank you. How was yours?
Sarah: It was quite productive. I am reaching out to check the status of the Q3 campaign slides.
David: I am finalizing the budget allocation slide right now. The rest is fully reviewed.
Sarah: Excellent. Please ensure the new compliance guidelines are reflected in the final section.
David: Yes, I have incorporated those updates as requested by legal.
Sarah: I appreciate your diligence. Kindly share the file link before our 2 PM sync.
David: I will send it over within the next hour.
Sarah: Thank you, David. I will look for it shortly.

Michael: did you finish unpacking all those boxes yet? mom is stressing out lol
Leo: almost done dad. just trying to figure out how to loft this bed 😅
Michael: make sure you use the rubber mallet i packed in your tool bag
Leo: found it! my roommate ben is helping me lift the frame rn
Michael: good good. send us a pic when the room is set up ok?
Leo: will do. also did mom sneak a bunch of cookies into my laundry basket?
Michael: haha you know she can't help herself. ration them out!
Leo: lol tell her i said thanks. i'll call you guys after dinner tonight
Michael: sounds great kiddo. proud of you.

Emily: babe can you grab some stuff from trader joe's on your way home?
Mark: yeah sure what do we need?
Emily: just some oat milk, eggs, and those spicy peanut noodles you like 🍜
Mark: nice i was totally craving those anyway. anything else?
Emily: oh and paper towels if they have the bulk pack!
Mark: got it. i'll be off work in 20 mins so i'll head there right after
Emily: you're the best 😘 drive safe!
Mark: thanks love. see you in like an hour

Robert: Good afternoon, Mrs. Hughes. I wanted to provide a quick update on the Maple Street property.
Diana: Good afternoon, Robert. Please tell me we have some good news.
Robert: The sellers have officially accepted our counteroffer. Congratulations on your new home!
Diana: That is absolutely wonderful news! We are thrilled.
Robert: I will be sending the preliminary paperwork to your email shortly.
Diana: Excellent. I will review it with my husband this evening and sign via DocuSign.
Robert: Perfect. Once that is completed, we will schedule the home inspection for early next week.
Diana: Thank you for your hard work on this, Robert.
Robert: It is my pleasure. Have a wonderful evening, Diana.

Chloe: hey are you wearing your black velvet slip dress this weekend??
Amanda: no why? do u need to borrow it again lol
Chloe: yes please!! i have a date on saturday and it fits me perfectly 🥺
Amanda: fine but u have to dry clean it this time! last time it smelled like bbq sauce
Chloe: omgg that was one time! i promise i'll take care of it
Amanda: alright it's hanging in the guest room closet. grab it whenever
Chloe: ur a lifesaver seriously 🙌
Amanda: yeah yeah just don't ruin it! have fun on your date
Chloe: will do sis 💖

Jessica: Good morning, Mr. Davis. I am writing to discuss Noah's upcoming math assessment.
Mr. Davis: Good morning, Dr. Miller. I would be happy to discuss Noah's progress with you.
Jessica: He has been struggling slightly with fractions at home. Are there specific worksheets we should focus on?
Mr. Davis: Yes, I noticed he needs a bit more practice. I will email you a supplemental packet this afternoon.
Jessica: That would be very helpful. We want to ensure he feels confident before the exam next Thursday.
Mr. Davis: Noah is a bright student; a little extra review will make a big difference.
Jessica: Thank you for your continued support and dedication to his learning.
Mr. Davis: You are very welcome. Please let me know if he has any questions on the packet.

Tyler: yo don't forget the conedison bill is due tmrw!
Kevin: ah right. how much is my half again?
Tyler: it came out to $64.50 this month. ac really ran up the tab 🥶
Kevin: brutal. just venmo'd you my half bro
Tyler: sweet just got it. ill submit the payment right now
Kevin: thanks man. btw i'm grabbing pizza on the way back, want a slice?
Tyler: definitely get me a pepperoni if u can 🍕
Kevin: bet. see ya in 30

William: Good morning, Mr. Evans. This is William from property management.
James: Good morning, William. How can I help you today?
William: I am reaching out to inform you that the building will have scheduled water maintenance tomorrow between 10 AM and 2 PM.
James: Thank you for the notice. Will the water be completely shut off during that time?
William: Yes, both hot and cold water will be temporarily unavailable. We advise storing some water in advance.
James: Understood. I appreciate the heads-up so I could plan my day accordingly.
William: Not a problem. We will post flyers in the lobby as well. Have a good day.
James: You too, William.

Olivia: hey girl! so are we still on for grandma's 80th surprise party? 🎉
Maria: yes totally! i already booked the private room at that italian place she loves
Olivia: amazing!! i'm handling the cake. does she still like red velvet best?
Maria: oh definitely. just make sure the frosting isn't too sweet lol
Olivia: noted! should we tell uncle joe to bring the old photo albums?
Maria: yes i'll text him today. he always forgets if we don't remind him
Olivia: perfect. this is going to be so much fun 💃
Maria: i know she's gonna cry happy tears! i'll send u the restaurant deposit receipt later
Olivia: sounds good cuzzie! talk soon

Jake: did you pay the electric bill yet? ⚡
Mark: oh man i totally forgot, doing it right now
Jake: cool, it's due tmrw so try not to miss it
Mark: just submitted the payment! it was $84 right?
Jake: yeah that sounds right. thanks dude
Mark: no worries. you working the morning shift tmrw?
ake: yep, gotta be at the cafe by 5am 😴
mark: brutal. i'll try to keep it down tonight then

Sarah: what time is your flight landing? ✈️
Emily: it got delayed a bit, should land around 4:30pm
Sarah: okay, your dad is going to pick you up at terminal 2
Emily: perfect. can we get tacos for dinner? im starving 🌮
Sarah: of course! we already bought the stuff to make them at home
Emily: yay! you guys are the best
Sarah: drive safe from the airport, see you soon!
Emily: see ya!

Marcus: Good morning, David. Did you review the Q3 earnings report I sent over?
David: Good morning, Marcus. I am looking at it right now.
Marcus: Please let me know if you see any discrepancies in the revenue projections.
David: Will do. I noticed the marketing expenses were slightly higher than expected.
Marcus: Yes, that was due to the new ad campaign launch in August.
David: Understood. I will finish the review by noon and send you my notes.
Marcus: Thank you, I appreciate the prompt response.

chloe: can you grab some milk on your way home? 🥛
luis: yeah sure, 2% or whole?
chloe: 2% please. and maybe some of those chocolate chip cookies? 🍪
luis: u got it. anything else?
chloe: nah that should be it. when do u think you'll be back?
luis: leaving the office in 10 mins, so probably around 6
chloe: awesome, i'm starting on dinner now
luis: smells good already haha see u soon

arthur: son, how do i connect the new printer to my laptop?
kevin: u just need to connect it to the wifi network first dad
arthur: it's asking for a wps pin. where do i find that?
kevin: it should be on a sticker on the back of the printer or on the screen
arthur: found it! typing it in now...
kevin: did it work?
arthur: yes! just printed a test page. thanks for the help
kevin: no prob dad, let me know if u need anything else 👍

mia: are u still coming to my graduation party this weekend? 🎉
liam: yeah definitely! wouldn't miss it. what time again?
mia: starts at 2pm at the park near my dorm
liam: sweet. u want me to bring any snacks or drinks?
mia: if u could bring some soda that would be amazing
liam: sure thing. mom and dad are driving down with me
mia: great, see you guys on saturday!

Evelyn: Hello Thomas. Do you have an update on the client presentation for tomorrow?
Thomas: Hello Evelyn. Yes, I have finalized the slides and just sent them to your inbox.
Evelyn: Thank you. I will review them before our 3 PM meeting.
Thomas: Sounds good. I made sure to include the revised timeline we discussed.
Evelyn: Excellent. Did you also update the budget estimates?
Thomas: Yes, the budget figures reflect the new vendor costs.
Evelyn: Perfect. Let's discuss the final details this afternoon.

tyler: dude are we still on for the basketball game tonight? 🏀
josh: yeah man! tickets are on my phone.
tyler: sick. where should we meet up before the game?
josh: let's meet at the sports bar down the street around 6
tyler: sounds like a plan. i'm bringing my buddy steve too if that's cool
josh: yeah totally fine. the more the merrier!
tyler: awesome, see u tonight bro

Robert: Good morning, Jessica. Have you made progress on the website redesign?
Jessica: Good morning, Robert. Yes, the new landing page is ready for your review.
Robert: Excellent. Could you send me the staging link?
Jessica: I just emailed it to roberthale.biz@gmail.com.
Robert: I see it now. The layout looks much cleaner, thank you.
Jessica: I am glad you like it. Let me know if you have any revisions.
Robert: I will send my feedback by tomorrow morning.

sam: guess who just got tickets to the concert!!! 🎤🤩
rachel: OMG NO WAY! how did u manage that?!
sam: i was in the queue for like 2 hours but i finally got them!
rachel: ur a lifesaver! i can't believe we're actually going
sam: right?! it's gonna be so much fun. u still owe me for half tho 😂
rachel: just venmo'd u! let's go shopping for outfits this weekend
sam: yes definitely! i need a new jacket for it
rachel: same! see u saturday babe 💕

Sarah: did you figure out what we are getting mom for her birthday yet? 🎁
Mark: i was thinking about that gardening set she talked about last week
Sarah: oh that's a great idea! do you want me to order it or will you?
Mark: i can grab it from home depot tomorrow after work 👍
Sarah: perfect. let me know how much my half is when you get it
Mark: will do. i'll text you the receipt later

Robert: Good morning, Angela. Please provide an update on the Q1 regional sales report.
Angela: Good morning, Robert. I am finalizing the last few slides right now.
Robert: Excellent. Will it be ready for my review before the 2 PM meeting?
Angela: Yes, I will send it to your inbox by 1 PM at the latest.
Robert: Thank you. Please ensure the new metric adjustments from yesterday are included.
Angela: They are already incorporated into the final charts. I will notify you once sent.
Robert: Much appreciated.

Chloe: hey Dave, do you happen to have a power drill i could borrow for an hour? 🛠️
Dave: yeah i sure do! what are you working on over there?
Chloe: just trying to hang these new floating shelves in the living room
Dave: nice. i'm in the garage right now if you want to come grab it
Chloe: you're a lifesaver! walking over now 😊
Dave: no rush, take your time
Chloe: thanks again, i'll bring it right back when i'm done!
Dave: keep it as long as you need

Michael: when is the last time you checked the oil in the civic?
Emily: honestly i can't remember... maybe before i left for campus? 😬
Michael: you need to check it today. the sticker said it was due at 45k miles
Emily: okay okay i will do it after my psychology class! 🙄
Michael: don't roll your eyes at me, i just don't want you stranded on the highway
Emily: i know dad, love you. i'll text you when it's done

William: Good afternoon, Mrs. Henderson. I wanted to update you on the blueprint revisions.
Sophia: Good afternoon, William. Have the city zoning issues been resolved?
William: Yes, we received the official approval this morning. We can proceed with the current layout.
Sophia: That is wonderful news. When can we schedule a walkthrough of the new plans?
William: I have availability this Thursday at 10 AM, if that suits your schedule.
Sophia: Thursday at 10 AM works perfectly for me. I will see you then.
William: Excellent. I will send a calendar invite shortly.

Jessica: are you picking up leo from daycare today or am i? 👶
Tom: i can get him! i'm leaving the office in about ten minutes
Jessica: awesome, thanks babe. i'm stuck doing chart reviews for another hour
Tom: no worries. do you want me to start cooking dinner when we get home?
Jessica: yes please! maybe just those leftover tacos from tuesday? 🌮
Tom: sounds like a plan. see you when you get home
Jessica: drive safe! love you guys
Tom: love you too

Kevin: Hello Arthur, I am writing to report a leak under the kitchen sink in unit 4B.
Arthur: Good afternoon, Kevin. Thank you for notifying me. Is the leak currently active?
Kevin: Yes, it drips continuously when the faucet is turned on. I have placed a bucket underneath for now.
Arthur: I appreciate you doing that. I will dispatch the plumber tomorrow morning between 9 AM and 11 AM.
Kevin: That time frame works for me. I will be working from home.
Arthur: Perfect. Please let me know if it worsens before then.

Marcus: yo are you going to aunt sandy's cookout this weekend? 🍔
Trey: yeah man i'm driving down on saturday morning
Marcus: sweet. can you give me a ride? my car is acting up again 🚗💨
Trey: for sure bro. what time should i pick you up?
Marcus: is 10 am too early? i want to make sure we get there before the ribs run out 😂
Trey: haha 10 works. just be ready when i pull up
Marcus: you know it. thanks man!
Trey: no problem. see you saturday
Marcus: bet.

Linda: Good morning, Mr. Peterson. This is Linda Harper from Oak Creek Middle School.
James: Good morning, Ms. Harper. Is everything alright with Lucas?
Linda: Yes, Lucas is doing fine. However, his homeroom teacher would like to schedule a brief conference with you regarding his upcoming science project.
James: Of course. I am available next Tuesday afternoon.
Linda: Would 3:30 PM on Tuesday work for you?
James: That is perfect. I will come to the main office to check in.
Linda: Thank you, Mr. Peterson. We look forward to seeing you.

Jake: hey mia are you using your car tonight? 🚗
Mia: no i'm just staying in to study. why?
Jake: my truck won't start and i need to get to practice 🏈
Mia: yeah you can take it. the keys are on the kitchen counter
Jake: you're the best! i will put some gas in it for you
Mia: you better! 😂 and don't change my radio stations
Jake: deal. see you later!

Elena: Good morning, David. Have you finished the handover documentation for your upcoming leave?
David: Good morning, Elena. Yes, I completed the files yesterday afternoon.
Elena: Excellent. Did you ensure the client contact list is updated as well?
David: I verified all the phone numbers and email addresses this morning.
Elena: Thank you, David. Enjoy your time off and we will connect when you return.
David: I appreciate it. Have a great week.

Brad: hey tom could you do me a huge favor this week? 🗑️
Tom: hey brad! sure thing, what do you need?
Brad: we are heading out of town for a few days and i forgot to pull the trash bins out
Tom: no problem at all man, i will roll them to the curb tomorrow night
Brad: thanks so much! i owe you a beer when we get back 🍻
Tom: sounds good to me. have a safe trip!

Nancy: chloe do you want me to make the sweet potato casserole for thursday? 🍠
Chloe: omg yes please! it's literally my favorite part of the meal
Nancy: i thought so. your dad is doing the turkey this year
Chloe: is uncle jim still bringing his famous pecan pie? 🥧
Nancy: yes he is. make sure you arrive by 4 pm so we can eat on time
Chloe: i will be there! love you mom
Nancy: love you too sweetie

Victor: Good afternoon, Sarah. I have reviewed the initial mockups for the new landing page.
Sarah: Good afternoon, Victor. I hope the design aligns with your vision for the brand.
Victor: The color palette is perfect, but I would like to make the call-to-action button slightly larger.
Sarah: That is an easy adjustment. I will implement the change and send a revised version by tomorrow.
Victor: That sounds great. Please also ensure the font size on the footer is readable on mobile devices.
Sarah: I will double-check the mobile responsiveness right now.
Victor: Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Liam: dude the microwave just sparked and died on me ⚡
Ben: are you serious? i literally just used it this morning
Liam: yeah it smells like burnt plastic in the kitchen right now 🤢
Ben: well i guess we have to buy a new one. target has some on sale
Liam: i can go grab one after my shift. want to split the cost?
Ben: yeah just send me a request when you get the total 💸
Liam: bet. i will try to find a cheap one

Olivia: Good morning, Mr. Davis. This is Olivia Benson, Tyler's math teacher.
Marcus: Good morning, Ms. Benson. Is everything okay with Tyler's grades?
Olivia: Tyler is doing quite well on his exams, but he has missed the last three homework assignments.
Marcus: I apologize, I was not aware he was falling behind on his daily work.
Olivia: I wanted to bring it to your attention so we can keep him on track for the semester.
Marcus: I will speak with him tonight and ensure he completes the missing pages.
Olivia: I appreciate your support, Mr. Davis. Have a wonderful day.

Greg: hey are you still at the grocery store? 🛒
Anna: just walking to the checkout now. did you forget something?
Greg: yeah can you grab a box of pasta and some marinara sauce? 🍝
Anna: sure i will run back to aisle 4 right now
Greg: you're the best! i will pick up the kids from soccer practice so you don't have to rush
Anna: thank you! i am exhausted today 😴
Greg: drive safe, see you at home

Jonathan: Good evening, Kevin. Have you had a chance to revise your resume draft?
Kevin: Good evening, Jonathan. Yes, I incorporated the feedback you provided on Tuesday.
Jonathan: Excellent. Please forward the updated document so I can review it before your interview.
Kevin: I just attached the PDF to our email thread.
Jonathan: I will read it over tonight and send you my final thoughts by tomorrow morning.
Kevin: Thank you so much for your guidance. I feel much more prepared now.
Jonathan: You are very welcome, Kevin. Good luck.

Maya: hey ria are we still doing the surprise party for grandma and grandpa? 🎉
Ria: absolutely! i already booked the venue for the 15th
Maya: awesome! i am in charge of the decorations, right?
Ria: yes! can you get some silver and gold balloons? 🎈
Maya: on it. how many people did we end up inviting?
Ria: about 40 people RSVP'd so far. it's going to be a full house
Maya: they are going to be so shocked! 😂
Ria: i can't wait!

Emma: are you wearing that black dress tonight or can i snag it? 👗
Chloe: i was actually going to wear it but you can take the blue one!
Emma: the navy blue one with the tie back?
Chloe: yeah that one. it's hanging on the back of my door
Emma: you're the best! i owe you a coffee tomorrow ☕
Chloe: make it an iced latte and we're even
Emma: deal! see you when you get home

Richard: Good morning, Melissa. Have you had a chance to review the Q4 revenue projections?
Melissa: Good morning, Richard. I am currently going through the final spreadsheet.
Richard: Excellent. I need the summary dashboard updated before our 3 PM board meeting.
Melissa: I will have it completed and uploaded to the shared drive by 1 PM.
Richard: Thank you. Please ensure the new marketing expenses are accurately categorized.
Melissa: They are already factored into the new models. I will ping you when it is ready.
Richard: Much appreciated, Melissa.

Brian: hey stan is your lawnmower working right now? 🚜
Stan: yeah it's running perfectly. why, is yours acting up again?
Brian: the pull cord just snapped on me halfway through the front yard 😤
Stan: man that is the worst. you can definitely come grab mine
Brian: thanks so much! i'll bring it right back when i finish
Stan: no rush at all, the garage side door is unlocked
Brian: heading over now!

Cynthia: Good afternoon, Jason. I am reaching out to schedule the annual HVAC inspection for your unit.
Jason: Good afternoon, Cynthia. Next week would be best for me.
Cynthia: The technicians have availability next Wednesday between 10 AM and 12 PM. Does that work?
Jason: Yes, I work from home on Wednesdays so I will be here to let them in.
Cynthia: Perfect. The inspection should only take about forty-five minutes.
Jason: Sounds good to me. Thank you for the advance notice.
Cynthia: You are very welcome. Have a great weekend.

Mark: did you remember to feed buster this morning before work? 🐕
Danny: yes dad, i gave him a full scoop and filled his water bowl
Mark: okay good. your mom was worried he would be hungry all day
Danny: tell her not to stress, he is totally fine!
Mark: i will. what time are you getting off today?
Danny: around 5, so i'll be over by 5:30 to walk him
Mark: see you then son, drive safe

Valerie: Good morning, Mr. Evans. I wanted to remind you that the permission slip for the museum field trip is due tomorrow.
Paul: Good morning, Ms. Chambers. I completely forgot to sign it last night.
Valerie: Not a problem at all. You can also print a copy from the school portal and email it to me.
Paul: I will download it on my lunch break and send it over this afternoon.
Valerie: Thank you, Mr. Evans. We really want Leo to join us for the exhibit.
Paul: He has been talking about the dinosaur bones all week. I will make sure it gets done.
Valerie: I will look out for your email later today.

Tyler: dude are you going to take care of those dishes tonight? 🍽️
Chris: my bad man, i had back to back classes all day
Tyler: it's cool just please do them before the weekend. it smells wild in there 🤢
Chris: i will knock them out as soon as i finish this essay
Tyler: sweet. also rent is due on monday so don't forget to transfer your half
Chris: already sent it through zelle like ten minutes ago 💸
Tyler: oh bet, i see it now. thanks man

Samuel: Good afternoon, Laura. Have you completed the final edits on the training seminar video?
Laura: Good afternoon, Samuel. I am currently exporting the final high-resolution file.
Samuel: Excellent. I need to upload it to the company intranet by tomorrow morning.
Laura: The export should take another twenty minutes, and then I will share the download link.
Samuel: Perfect. Did you manage to fix the audio syncing issue in chapter three?
Laura: Yes, the audio is now perfectly aligned with the slide transitions.
Samuel: I appreciate your diligence on this project, Laura.

Jessica: hey do you still have grandma's recipe for the tamales? 🫔
Maria: yes i actually have the original card in my kitchen drawer!
Jessica: omg you have to send me a picture of it. i want to make them for a potluck tomorrow
Maria: give me a sec, i'll go find it right now
Jessica: thank you!! did she use lard or vegetable oil in the masa?
Maria: she always used lard, that's what makes them so soft 🤤
Jessica: okay adding that to my grocery list now
Maria: just sent the photo! let me know how they turn out

Noah: Good morning, Dr. Harrison. I was wondering if you had a few minutes to review my database architecture plan this week.
Dr. Harrison: Good morning, Noah. I would be happy to take a look. How far along are you?
Noah: I have completed the schema draft, but I am uncertain about the indexing strategy.
Dr. Harrison: That is a common hurdle. Let us set up a brief video call for Friday morning to discuss it.
Noah: Friday morning works perfectly for me. Would 9:30 AM be convenient for you?
Dr. Harrison: Yes, 9:30 AM is fine. I will send you a meeting invite shortly.
Noah: Thank you so much for your guidance and time.

Kevin: are you going to be home this afternoon? 🏡
Dave: yeah i am just watching the game in the living room
Kevin: nice. do you mind if i borrow your extension ladder? my gutters are clogged again 🍂
Dave: go for it man. it is leaning against the side of the shed
Kevin: you are a lifesaver. i'll bring it right back when i finish
Dave: take your time! i don't need it today
Kevin: awesome, walking over now
Dave: sounds good

Alyssa: did you order dad's retirement gift yet?
Ryan: no i was waiting to see if you wanted to split the golf clubs we talked about 🏌️‍♂️
Alyssa: yes definitely! how much is my half going to be?
Ryan: the set is $400 so just venmo me $200 whenever you can
Alyssa: perfect, sending it right now. did you put the shipping address as his house?
Ryan: yeah it should arrive by thursday afternoon 📦
Alyssa: he is going to be so surprised!
Ryan: i know, i can't wait to see his face

Marcus: Good morning, Julia. I am following up on the Q2 vendor contracts.
Julia: Good morning, Marcus. I am reviewing the final redlines from the legal team right now.
Marcus: Excellent. Do you anticipate having them signed before the end of the day?
Julia: Yes, I will route them via DocuSign by 2 PM at the latest.
Marcus: Thank you for the update. Please copy me on the final execution emails.
Julia: I will make sure you are CC'd on all corresponding documentation.
Marcus: I appreciate your diligence on this.
Julia: You are very welcome.

Brenda: hailey did you unpack the boxes for your dorm yet? 📦
Hailey: mostly! i still have to organize my closet and set up the desk
Brenda: don't forget to plug in the mini fridge so it gets cold before you buy groceries
Hailey: oh shoot i totally forgot to plug it in 😂 doing it right now
Brenda: good. your dad and i put a $50 gift card in your bedside drawer for snacks
Hailey: you guys are the best! thank you so much ❤️
Brenda: of course sweetie. text me when you are going to sleep
Hailey: i will! miss you guys

Jason: can you grab some chicken breast on your way home? 🍗
Megan: yeah i am passing by trader joe's in about ten minutes
Jason: perfect. we also need some olive oil if you don't mind grabbing a bottle
Megan: adding it to my list. are you starting the rice soon?
Jason: just turned the stove on! dinner should be ready by 6:30
Megan: thank goodness, i am absolutely starving today 🤤
Jason: haha drive safe, see you in a bit
Megan: see you soon!

Gregory: Good afternoon, Sarah. I received your maintenance request regarding the broken air conditioning unit.
Sarah: Good afternoon, Gregory. Yes, it stopped blowing cold air entirely last night.
Gregory: I apologize for the inconvenience. I have contacted our HVAC contractor to come out tomorrow morning.
Sarah: That would be wonderful. Will they need me to be present in the apartment?
Gregory: Not necessarily, I can provide them with the spare key if you give me written permission to enter.
Sarah: You have my permission to let them in. I will be at the office all day.
Gregory: Thank you, Sarah. I will update you once the repair is complete.
Sarah: I appreciate it.

Chloe: the wifi bill just posted, your half is $35 📶
Jasmine: just sent it to your cashapp! did it go through?
Chloe: yep got it. also can you please wipe down the stove when you cook later? 🧽
Jasmine: omg i am so sorry, i was rushing to get to class this morning
Chloe: it's totally fine, just try to clean up the grease splatters next time
Jasmine: i will do it as soon as i get back to the apartment!
Chloe: thank you! trying to keep the kitchen clean before my parents visit
Jasmine: completely understand!

Evelyn: Good morning, Mr. Wright. I am reaching out to discuss Leo's progress in reading class.
Thomas: Good morning, Ms. Parker. Is he struggling with the new curriculum?
Evelyn: He is having a bit of trouble with reading comprehension and focusing during silent reading time.
Thomas: I appreciate you letting me know. How can we help him at home?
Evelyn: I recommend reading together for twenty minutes each evening and asking him questions about the story.
Thomas: We will start doing that tonight. Do you have any specific book recommendations?
Evelyn: I will email you a list of age-appropriate chapter books this afternoon.
Thomas: Thank you for your guidance, Ms. Parker.

Derek: are we still driving up to the lake house on friday? 🚗
Brian: yeah i took the whole day off work so we can leave early
Derek: sweet. should i bring the big cooler or are you bringing yours?
Brian: bring yours! mine has a crack in the lid and it doesn't hold ice well 🧊
Derek: okay i will pack it in the trunk. aunt mary said she is making her famous potato salad
Brian: let's gooo! that is literally the only reason i am going 😂
Derek: don't let her hear you say that! i'll swing by your place at 8 am
Brian: sounds like a plan. see you friday

Natalie: Good afternoon, Richard. I have attached the first draft of the website copy for your review.
Richard: Good afternoon, Natalie. Thank you for sending this over so quickly.
